preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of cities N must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(Ai) <= 50 and 1 <= len(Bi) <= 50 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)
preconditions.description: Each city name must have a length between 1 and 50 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ci <= 1000 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)

postconditions.description: The output must contain N lines, where N is the number of cities.

postconditions.description: The first N-1 lines of the output must contain the cards in their proper original order.
